<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Test RIGHT/LEFT movement

# Get player position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
        pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
        print(f"Player before: row={pr}, col={pc}")
        break

# Press RIGHT

    if n['color'] == 'O':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
        pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
        print(f"Player after RIGHT: row={pr}, col={pc}")
        break

# Press LEFT
print("\nPressing LEFT")
action(['LEFT'], intent='solve')

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'O':
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
        pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
        print(f"Player after LEFT: row={pr}, col={pc}")
        break

# Get bird positions
yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
print(f"\nBirds: {len(yellow_birds)}")
for n in yellow_birds:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    br = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2

    dist = ((br - pr)**2 + (bc - pc)**2)**0.5

</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
